description: This file is a C header file defining a printf-like printing function 'lp_Print' used for formatted output, along with related macros and include directives. It includes licensing and author information and sets up a function prototype for custom output handling.

methods.name: lp_Print
methods.description: A variadic function that performs formatted output by calling a user-provided output function. It accepts a function pointer for output, a user data argument, a format string, and a variable argument list.
